svg.title: Physical and virtual Bluetooth Controller paths
svg.desc: A physical device connects its Application and Bluetooth Host to a hardware Controller through HCI. In BSWorld, any Host can select either a Zephyr Controller process or a Python BSController worker thread through an H4 Unix socket. Each Host connects to one Controller instance. Both virtual Controller implementations contain HCI, Link Layer and radio logic, and connect directly to the shared BabbleSim PHY through radio FIFOs. A topology can mix both implementations.
svg.text: The same Application and Host, with interchangeable virtual Controllers.
